uniqueContent.blurb: Christmas falls on December 25th every year and is one of the most searched countdowns globally, with interest climbing sharply from late November through the day itself.
uniqueContent.historicalNote: The December 25th date was fixed in the 4th century and has stayed constant even as the Gregorian calendar reform shifted other observances.

faq.question: Is Christmas always on December 25th?
faq.answer: Yes, in the Gregorian calendar used by most countries. Some Orthodox churches observe it on January 7th instead.
